title: Sn$_{2}$F$_{3}$Cl Structure
comments: Sn$_{2}$F$_{3}$Cl occupies the same Wyckoff positions in space group $P2_{1}3$ \#198 as \href{current_web_home_dir/A4BC_cP24_198_ab_a_a-001}{$\beta$-SnWO$_{4}$}, and the ICSD assigns it to the SnWO$_{4}$ structure type. However the stoichiometry and hence the bonding are different, so we give it a separate AFLOW prototype label.
